glosses: to cross out, to make invalid, to cancel
alternative form of canceln (“to cause moral panic against someone”)

examples.text: Rittenhouse wurde von den Qualitätsmedien und den höchsten Repräsentanten der Politik haltlos beschuldigt, von den sozialen Medien kanzelliert, von den Faktencheckern verleumdet.
examples.translation: Rittenhouse fell victim to unwarranted accusations brought forward by fake news media and highest representatives of politics, being canceled by social media, libeled by fact checkers.
examples.english: Rittenhouse fell victim to unwarranted accusations brought forward by fake news media and highest representatives of politics, being canceled by social media, libeled by fact checkers.
